title: A New Beginning
author: TheArtistTree
content:
The micronation of Medoles is opening its doors, inviting you to join its vibrant community. Located in the United Counties of Leeds and Grenville, a micronation named Medoles declared its independence on the 24th of January 2024. The newly formed Medolite government has meticulously planned the future of the micronation, focusing on its democratic regime and how its people will forge their own path in this next chapter.

With this in mind, the emergent micronation has taken the next step towards a better tomorrow. The Medolite government now allows people to sign up and go through the process to obtain citizenship. Citizens of Medoles are not only free to interact with its community, but they can also contribute and partake in its politics, shaping the future of Medoles. Citizenship will be available to be given out on their Discord server.

The first set of elections for Medoles will be coming in soon, keep a close eye on them.
thumbdesc: Flag of Medoles with its geography in the background.

title: Candidates for Presidential Elections are Set!
author: TheArtistTree
content:
The nation has slowly been growing in the past weeks, and with that in mind, the elections have finally kicked off after a long wait. The signups were open on Sunday & Monday, and we're here to reveal the candidates participating in the first presidential elections of Medoles.

The first candidate to sign up is X-Man, one of the founding members of the Medoles. The independent candidate had this to say to launch his campaign: Hello, I am X-Man and I am running for the 1st presidential election of Medoles I plan to setup diplomacy and the staff team for Medoles so that the nation can startup with quick growth and stable staff.

X-Man won't be alone in this election. On the other side of the ring, we also have Sabermoose, the first non-founding citizen to have joined Medoles earlier this month. He'll be campaigning under the banner of the Conservative Party of Medoles and opens with the following speech: The goal of my Presidency would be to draft a longer and stronger constitution and establish diplomatic relations with other micronations

These elections ought to be an engaging presidential campaign to see who will earn the title of the first president. This is without mentioning more positions will also be decided on that are also up for grabs including the mayor and judge in the following weeks.

The vote will be open on Thursday the 20th of June 2024.
thumbdesc: Flag of Medoles with a ballot box in the foreground

title: Elections Take an Unexpected Turn!
author: TheArtistTree
content:
After Medoles had reached five citizens, the inaugural elections were on their way until they met an unexpected end. On the 11th of June, elections kicked off with the signups and received two plausible candidates. It means there would be only two feasible outcomes from these elections: X-Man and Sabermoose.

From what should have been a tight race with both candidates having points to prove and fight for, one of the candidates, X-man, had to pull out minutes before the voting ballot opened. When asked to elaborate on why he dropped from the race, X-Man responded: "No comment." It means that Sabermoose is, without a doubt, declared the 1st President of Medoles.

Will X-Man make a return for the following elections? And how will Sabermoose set a precedent for future presidents to abide by? Only the future can tell. Until then, we'll have to wait as the next elections on the list for the position of Mayor will open up on the 30th of June 2024.
thumbdesc: Flag of Medoles with a ballot box in the foreground crossed out

title: Parliament Passes Its First Historic Bill
author: TheArtistTree
content:
After a return to normalcy this holiday season and the re-election of X-Man, the parliament has finally opened its doors. Indeed, the Mayor Tree has begun the push for bills, with the first one about opening relations with another Canadian micronation, Westnia (formerly "Westania").

After 3 days, the result has been overwhelmingly positive to initiate our foreign policies. The Medolite citizens made it clear as the inaugural bill ended with a unanimous vote of 5-0 for establishing relations with Westania. It is the first of many bills on their way in the coming months for change.

The elections for Mayor will begin on Sunday the 29th of December 2024.

title: Two Bills Passed: Government's Agenda Gains Momentum
author: TheArtistTree
content:
With the parliament opening its doors last week, it has made significant progress in advancing legislation, setting new precedents in Medoles. After approving the first bill to establish relations with Westnia (formerly Westania), Mayor Tree moved forward with the government's agenda, proposing two more bills, with the results revealed earlier today.

The first bill suggested expanding their plans to grow their foreign influence by creating a list of relations where nations can be classified relative to their relationship with Medoles. The second bill further emphasizes it by forwarding a bill to join the GMNC (Great Micronation Census), also known as the GRMN (Grand Recensement des Micronations) in French. It's a French and English-speaking organization where micronations can meet and share announcements, descriptions and relations.

Both bills passed with relative ease and no opposition on the 24th of December 2024, the governmental agenda is going according to plan and begins to gain momentum. X-Man, the President of Medoles, expanded on this when he exclaimed: "For the second term of my presidency, I am working towards expanding Medoles' diplomatic influence within micronation communities and setting a foundation for further diplomacy within Medoles."

The elections for Mayor will begin on Sunday the 29th of December 2024.
